before: Compose took out a rejected column insertion's cells at every drawing and joined the whole grid each time, so a grid line that a later direct row deletion left unused was joined live but not after a fold.
after: The join happens only when a decision is drawn, and the settle step writes it into the items; later drawings only take the cells out.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest fields and the Yjs format do not change: every client runs the same settle step after the same decision change. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
